Code Editing from Few Editing Exemplars via Multi-Extent Composition
This paper considers the computer programming code editing with few editing exemplars.
We present the first machine learning approach to edit source code with few exemplars by adaptive multi-extent similarity ensemble.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel machine learning approach for code editing with few editing exemplars.

the following research questions: (1) How to learn the edit intention from few exemplars? (2) How to generalize the learned edit intention to a query code? (3) What are the challenges in applying the proposed approach to real-world code?
